certification.name: Investigating Windows Memory
certification.description: Windows memory forensics covering memory structures, acquisition, pagefile analysis and analysis with Volatility, MemProcFS and WinDbg. Certification is earned by passing the course Knowledge Assessment, which has a multiple-choice part and a hands-on practical part; it does not expire.
certification.currency_note: Course price with 365-day access; one certification attempt (Knowledge Assessment) is included and is not sold separately
